svg.title: SYNTHETIC DEMO · comparable research runs
svg.desc: Eligible trial receipt scores versus elapsed wall-clock hours since campaign creation. Steps show best observed among captured points, not confirmed winners. Dashed lines show each run's eligible original baseline when available. Best observed is carried to report capture time, not extrapolated improvement. No worker count, training-time or speedup inference is made.
